overview_description.description:
GigFinesse is tearing up the old booking playbook.

Powered by AI and backed by white-glove service, our platform pairs venues with the perfect talent in seconds—no middlemen, no guesswork. As the hospitality industry’s fastest-growing live-entertainment engine, we’re installing a new operating system for how shows get booked.

product.name: Talent Booking Platform
product.description: A platform that connects venues with artists to facilitate booking live entertainment and manage event details.

product.name: Back-Office Digitization Service
product.description: A service that digitizes and manages contracts, insurance, and tax forms related to live entertainment bookings.

product.name: Performance Dashboard
product.description: A centralized dashboard to manage all event details including artist arrival, performance, and payment tracking.

product.name: Marketing Tools
product.description: Tools that generate custom promotional materials like posters and enable website integration to promote live events.
